facts.en: Completed a retail numeracy and stock-records course at Fictional Bayquill Learning Centre in 2022; the course issued an attendance record, not a trade qualification.
facts.zh: 2022 年在虚构湾羽学习中心完成零售计算与库存记录课程；课程颁发出勤记录，而非行业资格。

facts.en: Paid market-stall setup assistant at Fictional Reedlight Produce Market from 2018-04 to 2022-12.
facts.zh: 2018-04 至 2022-12 在虚构苇光农产市场任有薪摊位布置助理。

facts.en: In that role, set out empty crates, posted supplier-prepared price cards and cleared the stall after trading.
facts.zh: 在该岗位摆放空筐、张贴供应商准备的价格卡，并在营业结束后清理摊位。

facts.en: Paid order-packing assistant at Fictional Silvergill Fish Market from 2023-02 to 2026-08.
facts.zh: 2023-02 至 2026-08 在虚构银鳃鱼市场任有薪订单包装助理。

facts.en: Matched prepared fish packs to customer order numbers and the counter supervisor’s product labels.
facts.zh: 将已准备的鱼货包装与客户订单编号及柜台主管的产品标签匹配。

facts.en: Used a bench scale to record packed-order weights according to the supplied packing sheet.
facts.zh: 依据所提供包装单，使用台秤记录包装订单重量。

facts.en: Added the ice packs specified on the packing sheet and kept their count separate from fish product weight.
facts.zh: 加入包装单指定的冰袋，并将冰袋数量与鱼货产品重量分开记录。

facts.en: Helped reconcile dispatch records for a single wholesale order on 2025-11-14.
facts.zh: 2025-11-14 协助核对一笔批发订单的发货记录。

facts.en: That order contained 48 kg of prepared fish product and 12 reusable ice packs; the ice packs were not included in the 48 kg product figure.
facts.zh: 该订单包含 48 千克已准备鱼货及 12 个可重复使用冰袋；48 千克产品数值不含冰袋。

facts.en: Personally matched the order labels and recorded the ice-pack count; the supervisor verified the product identity and approved dispatch.
facts.zh: 个人匹配订单标签并记录冰袋数量；主管核实产品身份并批准发货。

facts.en: Recorded customer collection times and passed late-collection queries to the counter supervisor.
facts.zh: 记录客户取货时间，并将延迟取货咨询转交柜台主管。

facts.en: Set aside packages with missing or unreadable labels pending the supervisor’s review.
facts.zh: 将标签缺失或无法辨认的包装留置，等待主管审核。

facts.en: Uses printed order tickets, a label printer and spreadsheet totals for end-of-shift order reconciliation.
facts.zh: 使用纸质订单票据、标签打印机及电子表格汇总进行班末订单核对。

facts.en: Completed the fish market’s internal packing-area hygiene induction in 2023-02.
facts.zh: 2023-02 完成鱼市场内部包装区卫生入职培训。

facts.en: Restocked clean outer boxes and washed reusable crates under the market’s written cleaning routine.
facts.zh: 按照市场书面清洁流程补充干净外箱，并清洗可重复使用的周转箱。

facts.en: Volunteered at Fictional Moonbarrow Food-Box Club from 2021-03 to 2021-11, assembling empty donation cartons and checking collection lists.
facts.zh: 2021-03 至 2021-11 在虚构月车食品箱社做志愿者，组装空捐赠纸箱并核对领取清单。

facts.en: Co-organized a second-hand cookbook table at that club with 2 other volunteers; personally made the category signs.
facts.zh: 与另外 2 名志愿者共同组织该社的二手食谱书摊；个人制作分类标牌。

facts.en: Keeps a personal illustrated notebook of invented market-stall layouts, separate from employer plans.
facts.zh: 保留个人图解笔记，描绘虚构市场摊位布局，与雇主方案分开。

facts.en: Enjoys weaving small baskets from paper strips.
facts.zh: 爱好用纸条编织小篮子。

facts.en: The market role was order packing and collection support, not fish preparation, product inspection or health-and-safety sign-off.
facts.zh: 该市场岗位负责订单包装及取货支持，不涉及鱼货加工、产品检验或健康安全签署批准。
